normalization_notes: The Weave export omits null fields present in raw SDK model dumps. All 27 choices match after removing null dictionary fields; content and finish_reason match without normalization.

No copied source payload fields were removed or changed for comparison. Only replay_source was removed from the replay payload, as declared by its provenance.

independence.limit: Independent calls and histories do not prove independent or correct reasoning; refinements intentionally share peer findings.
